**What this changes**

**Checklist**

- [ ] Any new/edited `.dot` sources were re-rendered (`dot -Tsvg` / `dot -Tpng`) and the
      committed SVG/PNG updated to match — the `Verify diagrams` CI check will fail
      otherwise.
- [ ] Any new page is linked from `README.md`'s table of contents and body.
- [ ] No machine-identifying details (real hostnames, usernames, IPs) were introduced —
      this repo genericizes the source hostname to "the-box" in prose.
